Sanofi R&D: why is the organization described as a matrix organization?
fields.Back:
Because Function Heads (CMC, Regulatory, …) sit in two places at once:

• in the governance committees, AND
• supplying functional representatives to the GPT

So a function reaches a project both top-down (governance) and sideways (team membership).

fields.Front: Sanofi R&D: what does GPT stand for, and what is it?
fields.Back:
Global Product/Brand Team — the cross-functional team supporting the GPH, responsible for executing the project strategy across all disciplines.

Representatives from: Clinical, CMC, Regulatory, Safety, Market Access, Commercial, etc.
